Off by default. The log will then name songs and folders: share it only with someone you trust.

Written: the app\'s own lines about the DAC and its EQ, the audio route and format, the volume ceiling, Dedicated mode and the lock screen, the sleep timer and the library scan\'s counters; USB, route and power events; the output\'s one-second summaries every 10 seconds and the stream\'s state every minute; the phone model and the Android and app versions. Not written: titles, artists, albums, playlists, file names and paths, web addresses, e-mail and account names, serial numbers, or the names of Bluetooth devices. Nothing is sent: the log leaves the phone only if you share it.
